A Rust program can reach every callable step: a reduced title (no expressions, easing assistants, graph, solid or adjustment effects) can be authored as records and rendered to DNxHR and AV1; this resembles existing harness tests but was not run, so it is UNVERIFIED. runner_notes.fixtures: Generate the input_assets by script with a fixed seed; keep the plate's homography, the matte of the hand and the music transient times as ground truth files beside them. No proprietary material.
runner_notes.today_path: Rust test-style driver with feature media: write_package, Run::open_bytes, Session::set_composition_records and set_motion_records, FrameRenderer::frame_at for stills, session_render_queue_jobs plus reel ExportQueue for files. Steps with status engine_only or missing are recorded as skipped with their gap, never faked.
runner_notes.after_drive: When SMB-HARNESS-DRIVE-1 lands, command_id values here are its ids. Steps with command_id document.set_document_entry should move to STUDIO_* ids once they exist; spec_command_label names the spec row to bind.
runner_notes.determinism: Fixed ticks (254016000000 per second, 25 fps = 10160640000 ticks per frame, as in hsk-studio-harness/tests/render_queue_records.rs:20-21). CPU backend for digests; the effect kernels state byte stability per platform and backend (composition/effect_stack.rs:20-23). Motion-JS: fixed Date profile and seed per STU-MOT-256.

comparison.frames: Decode outputs, compare to analytic expectations at chosen points, then a digest per platform for regressions.
comparison.track: Corner error against the plate homography, in pixels per frame, threshold set before the run.
comparison.key and roto: Matte against ground truth by mean absolute error, with worst frame reported.
comparison.records: After save and reopen, composition and motion entries are byte-identical.
comparison.gui: Argus or screenshot review against each visual_check; GUI build is pure Vulkan so selectors must be stable author ids; attach STU-SHL-108 gesture node reads for drag checks.

cautions: A 150-layer plate is a workaround: time and memory unmeasured.
Whole-record rewrites have no undo unless sent through restructure_and_entry or set_tiles_and_entry.
Rendering is long: run through the project's cargo and artifact rules; this scenario authored nothing of that kind.
